conflicts.fact: Type of germination in maize and the fate of the cotyledon: lesson 4 and 10 say maize is hypogeal and bean epigeal, but lesson 2's seed structure says maize cotyledon (scutellum) stays in the seed; the term 'cotyledon stays below ground' is also applied to maize in lessons 4 and 10. This is consistent, but lesson 10's evidence sentence says 'Maize remained underground with cotyledon (hypogeal)' versus 'bean cotyledons rose' while lessons 2 and 4 both agree. Not a true conflict.
Which lesson introduces the question 'Do we have hormones in plants?' and what the next lesson is (order of Lessons 6, 7, 8)
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 adds 'Do we have hormones in plants?' to the DQB and sets it as the focus of Lesson 7. Lesson 7 (hormones) ends with the new question 'How can we measure growth?' and points to Lesson 8 for measuring. Lesson 8 (measuring growth) again ends with 'Do we have hormones in plants?' as the question for Lesson 9. Lesson 6 already measures growth and plots a growth curve, so the sequence loops.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson ends with the question 'How can you measure growth in plants?' vs. when growth curves are first measured
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 ends with 'How can you measure growth in plants?' leading to Lesson 6. Lesson 6 already measures growth and plots a growth curve; Lesson 7 and 8 then ask again how to measure growth and measure seedlings.

conflicts.fact: Maize vs bean growth data: height values for maize and bean differ and the pattern of shape of the growth curve
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 gives maize rising from 4 cm to 32 cm between days 7 and 21 and beans from 3 to 18 cm. Lesson 8 back-up data gives maize 8 cm at Day 6, 32 cm at Day 12 and 62 cm at Day 21, beans 3 cm at Day 6 and 21 cm at Day 21. Maize at Day 7 to 21 differs (32 vs 62 cm; bean 18 vs 21 cm).

conflicts.fact: Location of the farmer and place names in the phenomenon
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: Nakuru County / Molo (Rift Valley); Lesson 3 and 4: Kitale/Trans Nzoia; Lesson 5: Kakamega; Lesson 6: Nakuru; Lesson 7: Kakamega; Lesson 10: Bungoma. The same farmer is placed in different places.

conflicts.fact: Which question comes first on the DQB and the model/day names
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says the first new question is 'What is growth and development?' and Lesson 2 says the dormancy question is raised at the end; consistent. Lesson 1 mentions 'Day 0, 3, 7, 14 and 25' time-lapse, Lesson 8 uses Days 0-21; not a conflict.
Lesson 2: growth is irreversible increase in size, dry mass or cell number. Lesson 10: growth is an increase in size.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson the seedlings for measuring were started
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8 says seedlings grown 'since Lesson 5'; Lesson 6 uses seedlings germinated in damp cloth for 3-4 days and Lesson 8 measures Days 0-21 from the class nursery.

conflicts.fact: Hormones listed in the conclusion and ethylene
conflicts.versions: Lesson 10 lists auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins and abscisic acid; lessons 7 and 9 also include ethylene.
